from datetime import timedelta
from django.db.models import Q
from django.utils import timezone
from django.conf import settings
from apps.catalog.models import Offer, OfferCandidate, ProductFamily, ExternalMetricsSnapshot
from apps.catalog.services.public_eligibility import public_eligibility_q
from apps.catalog.services.weekly_discovery import PENDING_CAP_PER_FAMILY
from apps.catalog.services.observation_display import observation_history_queryset
now = timezone.now()
assert settings.PUBLIC_INDEXING_ENABLED is False and settings.DEBUG is False
families = list(ProductFamily.objects.exclude(status=ProductFamily.Status.RETIRED).order_by("display_order", "name", "pk"))
assert len(families) == 5
eligible = Offer.objects.filter(public_eligibility_q(now),is_active=True,owner_hidden=False,family_placements__product_family__in=families).distinct()
unproven = eligible.filter(Q(ship_from_country__isnull=True) | Q(ship_from_verified_at__isnull=True)).count()
print("PUBLIC_FAMILIES=" + str(len(families)))
print("ELIGIBLE_OFFERS=" + str(eligible.count()))
print("ORIGIN_INDIVIDUAL_UNPROVEN=" + str(unproven))
for family in families:
    pending = OfferCandidate.objects.filter(product_family=family,status=OfferCandidate.Status.PENDING).count()
    print("QUEUE_" + family.slug + "=" + str(pending) + ";PAUSED=" + str(int(pending >= PENDING_CAP_PER_FAMILY)))
for source in ("ALIEXPRESS", "META"):
    snap = ExternalMetricsSnapshot.objects.filter(source=source).first()
    status = "missing" if snap is None else ("fresh" if snap.checked_at <= now and now - snap.checked_at <= timedelta(hours=12) else "stale")
    print("METRICS_" + source + "=" + status)
print("INDEXING_DISABLED=pass")
assert observation_history_queryset().query is not None
'
